explanationMd: For a number between 0 and 1, decreasing a positive exponent increases the value. Thus $x^{1/2}>x>x^2>x^3$.

distractorRationale.b: Assumes the largest exponent produces the largest value.
distractorRationale.c: Does not account for the effect of a square root below 1.
distractorRationale.a: Assumes squaring always increases a positive number.
